thread:
elaine (SecOps): Hey team — quick security advisory: we found several long-lived sessions tied to the legacy corporate VPN (vpn-old.redwood) from accounts that haven't used ZTNA. We need everyone still on vpn-old to migrate by EOD 2026-03-27.

ash (Infra): How many sessions did you see?

elaine (SecOps): Small number (~12 active sessions), a mix of SRE and some external consultants. No evidence of lateral movement but it's stale access we want gone. We're going to deprecate vpn-old on 2026-03-28 and revoke any non-ZTNA tokens.

maria (Platform): OK — what's the migration flow? I haven't onboarded my contractor yet.

elaine (SecOps): Steps are here: https://confluence.redwood/team-security/ztna-migration 
1) Install the ZTNA client (supported: mac/linux/win)
2) Authenticate via SSO and enroll device policy
3) Run the attest command and paste the output into the onboarding form

Commands:```curl -s https://ztna.redwood/install.sh | bash
rzna-attest --team platform --upload```

elaine (SecOps): If you can't install, file a ticket to infra-access and include your device serial + OS. We will not grant exceptions after the cutoff.

ash (Infra): Are we automating revocation for non-compliant active sessions?

elaine (SecOps): Yes — on 2026-03-28 03:00 UTC we'll run a script to remove legacy VPN sessions and expire long-lived certs. We'll post a final reminder 24h before.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: ztna-migration-final-reminder at 2026-03-27T03:00:00Z

maria (Platform): Will this affect CI runners that still use vpn-old for deployment to on-prem?

ash (Infra): Good call. We've identified two CI jobs. I'll patch them to use the new tunnel and post the change here by EOD.

jordan (CTO): We should be explicit about contractors — any external accounts not migrated will be suspended. No exceptions unless approved by security.

elaine (SecOps): Agreed. Also: rotate any long-lived service tokens that referenced vpn-old or legacy certs. If you manage service accounts, please confirm rotation in this thread once complete.

sre-alert-bot: Detected 2 CI jobs referencing vpn-old in repo infra/ci-config — creating issue #452 in infra-access.

maria (Platform): Confirmed — rotated service token for analytics-ingest and updated job to use ZTNA tunnel. marking done. :white_check_mark:

ash (Infra): Patched the two CI jobs and notified contractors. :thumbsup:

elaine (SecOps): Thanks. Last call: final reminder will go out 24h before deprecation and we'll revoke access on 2026-03-28 03:00 UTC. If you need help, DM me or open infra-access ticket.

jordan (CTO): Thanks everyone — big help keeping our posture tight. :rocket:
